title: Notify about a written-off heavy vehicle
summary: Learn how to notify Transport for NSW about a written-off heavy vehicle so it can be recorded on the Written-Off Heavy Vehicles Register.
intro:
Transport for NSW must be notified if a heavy vehicle has been written-off so it can be recorded on the Written-Off Heavy Vehicles Register (WOHVR).

You must notify within 7 days after:
what_you_need: The completed form: Written-Off Heavy Vehicles Register Notification – PDF

how_to_steps.text: Download the form Written-Off Heavy Vehicles Register Notification – PDF.
Return the completed form using the details on the form.
